input_guard: No float/bool decision coercion; known integral input microseconds; observed flow in [-1,1]
input_primitive_masks: Traded prices/sizes/ratios must be finite and physically valid; undefined return/signed-impact and interarrival retain original explicit masks; no-trade bins retain original has_trade mask.
input_empty_masks: Known Boolean empty_bin must equal trade_count==0; integral nonnegative trade/aggregate counts agree; empty bins have zero volume, notional and interarrival count. Original definitions and legitimate missing-observation masks preserved.
